title: Tech Note: Plug-in support with Print Form
author: Thomas Maul, General Manager, 4D
featured_technology: Print form Detail/Break areas and dynamic resizing

historical_commentary.text: This note documents a 4D 2004.5 feature enabling plug-ins like 4D Write to be printed within Print Form output, extending a prior invoice-printing example to support styled text and embedded pictures with automatic pagination/splitting across pages. The core problem — printing variable-length rich content that must split cleanly across page boundaries — is still a real challenge in reporting today, but the specific tools involved (Print Form, 4D Write as a standalone plug-in, 4D Insider for copying methods between databases) predate 4D Write Pro (2016) and are largely superseded by more modern reporting/printing approaches in current 4D.
related_updates: 4D Write (the classic plug-in referenced here) was superseded by 4D Write Pro, introduced in 4D v15 (2016), with a modern rich text engine and different API
4D Insider, used here for copying reusable method groups between databases, is a legacy tool tied to the pre-Project-Mode Design Mode structure file workflow
